meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后,Codex 每次成功调用 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类工具时,插件都会触发 PostToolUse 钩子;若 comment-checker 报出警告,Codex 会收到阻断性反馈,需要先修复或解释被标记的注释。
howto.when: 当 Codex 成功完成一次编辑类工具调用(如 apply_patch、write、edit 等)后自动触发;非编辑类工具会被该插件忽略。

say.text: 看一下 comment-checker 报的警告,先修掉再继续
say.note: Codex 会先处理被标记的注释

say.text: 解释一下这条被标记的注释为什么保留
say.note: Codex 会说明或改为修正该注释

say.text: 把被标记的注释改掉,然后接着做原来的任务
say.note: 改完后 Codex 继续后续工作

howto.what_en: After install, the plugin fires a PostToolUse hook on successful apply_patch, write, and edit calls. If comment-checker reports a warning, Codex receives blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before moving on.
howto.when_en: Triggers automatically after Codex successfully finishes an edit-like tool call such as apply_patch, write, or edit. Non-edit tools are ignored by this plugin.

say_en.text: Check the comment-checker warning and fix it before continuing
say_en.note: Codex handles the flagged comment first

say_en.text: Explain why that flagged comment should stay
Change the flagged comment, then finish the original task
